s.d: (Hinduism) loving devotion to a deity leading to salvation and nirvana; open to all persons independent of caste or sex
a preparation of the leaves and flowers of the hemp plant; much used in India
(uncountable) A traditional South Asian preparation made from the leaves and flowers of the cannabis plant, consumed in food or drink.

x: Stramonium seed, mixed with wine, produces, according to a seventeenth century erotologist, libidinous activity. The effects, the write asserts, are similar to those produced by bhang.
He rolled out from under Zelikman, who looked surprised as if by the turn his bhang dream had taken.
